en.title: Sketch Brawl Judge Tutorial
en.subtitle: Follow this guide to evaluate the hot-seat demo within a few minutes.

steps.title: 1. Prepare the Environment
bullets: Open two browser windows (Player A and Player B) and load the Match page.
Keep the telemetry dashboard tab handy to monitor latency and inference SLA.
Verify your speakers/headphones if you plan to record the walkthrough video.

steps.title: 2. Draw Phase (Players Alternate)
bullets: Select the player slot (A/B) and the doodle type (Monster → Skill → Reinforcement).
Sketch quickly; look for the attribution panel to show element, HP, attack, and explanations.
If reinforcement is selected, pick an existing skill card and add strokes to boost stats.

steps.title: 3. Launch Battle & Review Timeline
bullets: Press Start Battle for immediate playback or Queue Async Battle to stream events live.
Watch the Battle HUD: snapshots, HP bars, and per-round summaries must match the server log.
If needed, refresh `/battles/{id}` or the SSE feed to compare deterministic results.

steps.title: 4. Capture Evidence
bullets: Take screenshots of latency metrics (<50 ms strokes, >=60 FPS) and battle timelines.
Record a ≤90 s walkthrough video covering draw → attribution → battle → reinforcement.
Download the replay/export bundle (once generated) for inclusion in the submission.

zh.title: Sketch Brawl 评审教程
zh.subtitle: 按照此流程快速体验并记录演示证据。

steps.title: 1. 准备环境
bullets: 打开两个浏览器窗口（玩家 A / 玩家 B），进入 Match 页面。
保持遥测仪表板窗口，以便观察延迟和推理 SLA。
如果需要录制讲解视频，提前确认麦克风 / 音频设备。

steps.title: 2. 轮流绘制
bullets: 选择玩家席位（A/B）以及涂鸦类型（怪兽 → 技能 → 强化）。
快速完成绘制，稍候即可在属性面板看到元素、血量、攻击和解释。
当选择强化时，点击已有技能卡，再继续作画提升该技能。

steps.title: 3. 启动战斗并检查时间线
bullets: 点击 Start Battle 立即播放，或使用 Queue Async Battle 体验实时事件流。
关注 Battle HUD：怪物截图、HP 条和每回合摘要都必须与后端日志一致。
如需复核，可刷新 `/battles/{id}` 或 SSE 流，确保结果可复现。

steps.title: 4. 收集证据
bullets: 截图保存延迟指标（<50 ms 笔画、>=60 FPS）及战斗时间线。
录制 ≤90 秒演示视频，覆盖绘制 → 解释 → 战斗 → 强化完整流程。
下载回放 / 导出包（生成后）并附在最终提交材料中。
